checks: All tests in this source (score module tests excluded)
cost: Bounded constant fixtures, maximum story3 sentences; costs inherit production routines at tiny N/M. Empty eval executes all configurations with zero documents. No performance inference.
description: Hand-authored synthetic CoNLL-U stories exercising actual resolver, format, document and evaluation APIs.
forward: row maps short fixture columns to ten-column CoNLL-U; sent adds comments and ids; story builds three-sentence title/appos/reflexive/relative chain. Assertions compare externally specified chain texts/reasons, speaker partitions, stripped-gold output, read/write spans, it readings and strict-before-notional choice. Added wave27 checks cover document failure precedence/quotes/retree, nested Entity/head tie, coordination visibility and event/empty-eval behavior. Lexicon tests build hand trees for each path and its negative controls, decide thresholds on a hand table, check the rotation is a derangement, and resolve «it» with and without a thread-local table.
inverse: For the vector of passing outcomes, compatible implementations are all programs agreeing on these bounded assertions; infinitely many disagree elsewhere. For serialized fixtures, row's lowercase lemma and omitted default MISC collapse antecedent short-column strings.
limitations: Finite fixtures; no model accuracy/corpus assertions, property exhaustiveness, performance or allocation-failure evidence.
Partial lexical syntax; no executable percentage surrogate; no corpus or universal proof.
state: In-memory fixtures plus resolver/sys observations; no corpus or teacher access.
